"""Coverage forms for tool_module_imports_own_family_only (G0 review finding 4): a `from X
import a` family (X itself names no family; the combined `X.a` does), a bare `import X` family,
the `application.models.requests.` prefix, the `application.models.responses.` prefix, and an
import nested inside a function -- ast.walk must see that last one, not just the module body.
This module's own family is `flow`, so none of the four other-family names below (`page`,
`item`, `widget`, `gadget`, `dataset`) collide with it.

Also calls `repo.publish()`: the reference port_methods_without_use_case's fixture
(application/interfaces/flow_port.py.txt) proves must not count as a use, because this module
sits under infrastructure/, not application/use_cases/."""

from __future__ import annotations

from app.application.use_cases import page
import app.application.use_cases.item.simulate
from app.application.models.requests.widget.x import Req
from app.application.models.responses.gadget.y import Resp


def call_publish(repo) -> None:
    """A reference to `.publish` that must NOT count as a use for port_methods_without_use_case."""
    repo.publish()


def local_import():
    """A function-local import: tool_module_imports_own_family_only must still see it."""
    from app.application.use_cases.dataset import z

    return z


_ = (page, app.application.use_cases.item.simulate, Req, Resp)
